name: United Neighborhoods
description: United Neighborhoods was a Chicago-based coalition of predominantly Puerto Rican street gangs, founded in 1969 by the Warlords and Spanish Lords as a mutual non-aggression and defense pact against white greaser clubs such as the Gaylords, Chi-West, and Taylor Jousters. The Insane Unknowns joined in 1974, the YBO/GBO in 1977, and the Latin Kings and M.A. Players in 1979. The alliance was centered in the Wicker Park and Bucktown neighborhoods and extended into West Humboldt Park. It predated the People/Folk split of 1978, after which member gangs largely aligned with the People Nation.
